Tuition & Financial Aid
Apply with confidence
Getting an advanced degree can be a rewarding chapter of your professional and personal journey. Submitting an application is the first step on your path to success.
To help you get started and navigate the application process with confidence, we’ve compiled helpful information and resources below.
Application information
The application process is your opportunity to share your unique experiences, motivations, and ambitions. Learn more about the process, deadlines, and requirements, and get tips to make your application shine.
Learn how to apply
Tuition and financial aid
Investing in your future shouldn’t have to be a financial burden in the present. Learn more about graduate school costs and the broad range of funding opportunities designed to help you pursue your goals.
Explore tuition and financial aid
Student benefits
Success isn’t one-size-fits-all. No matter your background, you can design your educational experience and find the support resources you need to best achieve your goals.
Discover student benefits
Scholarships
Scholarships are an excellent source of aid to help you finance your education. Explore our comprehensive list of available scholarships and other gift-based funding opportunities.
View available scholarships
Supporting a workforce in transition
Professionals in many of America’s largest economic sectors—including the federal government—are confronting uncertainty and sudden changes to their career outlooks. In response, Northeastern is offering generous scholarships and educational pathways for affected individuals to reskill, rebuild, and make their next professional move.
Support for professionals in career transitions
Resources for federal workforce employees
We're here to help
Wondering if Northeastern is the right fit for you? Have questions about your application? Our team of dedicated enrollment counselors is here to help throughout your journey—from application to graduation and beyond.
Speak with an enrollment counselor
Learn more about what an enrollment counselor does
